issues.description: Ingest writes valid rows to SQLite before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, so a command can return failure while still mutating the database.
Failure reporting only matches FAILED, TIMEOUT, and OOM, missing real Slurm states such as OUT_OF_MEMORY and likely underreporting failures.
AllocTRES parsing accepts negative GPU counts, producing negative GPU-hour totals.
GPU parsing sums both aggregate and typed gres/gpu keys, which can double-count when exports contain both forms.
Timestamps with timezone offsets are accepted but stored without normalization, making later string comparisons chronologically unreliable.
Report windows compare timestamp TEXT values directly in SQLite, which is fragile for mixed date formats or timezone-aware values.
Report commands silently create and initialize a missing database path, so a typo returns empty reports instead of an error.
CSV rows with extra pipe-delimited fields are not rejected because DictReader extras are ignored.
Project has pytest configuration but no linting, formatting, type-checking, or security-check tooling configured.
Malformed-ingest test checks the nonzero exit code but not that the failed ingest leaves the database unchanged.
